title: Unit Event — From the Marks Left Behind — Episode8 After The Shoot

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! starts looking at candidates for their new home base, the MORE MORE HOUSE. However, finding a place that fits their criteria proves rather difficult...

rows.Line: TV Station - Studio

rows.Speaker: TV Crew
rows.Line:
That's a wrap!
Thank you all very much for your hard work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... A lot happened, but we somehow managed to make it through!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! And it was great how the audience knew what we were talking about while we were trying those snacks!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad we shared those with them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's also a lot I'd like to talk about...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we should start preparing for our next engagement.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The interview for that house...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot!
It's at eight, right? What time is it now...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Seven?!
It's already this late?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We did have quite a bit of a delay, but we may still be able to make it in time.

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: The audience will now be exiting the studio!

rows.Speaker: Yuika
rows.Line: Oh, I should go see them out.

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line:
Me too!
I wanna hear what they thought of the show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
They're leaving...
We should also say goodbye to them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But staying means running late for our interview.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Getting approved was already supposed to be hard, so being late would probably mean an instant fail.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Which means we'd have to find a new house.
But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I still want to see them out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They had to wait so long because of that delay, so I feel we should thank them one last time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, also... I wanna thank the crew and other personalities for all their hard work...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Me three!
I was just thinking the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll need to apologize to the landlady and give a thorough explanation of what happened...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But for now, let's focus on the task at hand.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll ask Saito to let Ms. Kawanishi know that we'll be running late.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyway, let's head on over!

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line:
How great were they?
Not only were they willing to give the crew a hand, they kept the morale of the audience and personalities up.

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line: Yeah, they did such an amazing job...

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line: I guess idols are idols no matter where they go, huh?

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line:
You haven't heard that before?
It's something a legendary idol once said that everyone in the business hears by word of mouth.

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line: The stage isn't the only place where idols spread hope.

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line: And I think those girls are well on their way to embodying that ideal.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: No, I should be apologizing for always causing you so much trouble. Please don't ever hesitate to contact me.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Phew...
At least I don't have to rush back now.

rows.Speaker: Audience Member Ａ
rows.Line: Man, MORE MORE JUMP! was so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Audience Member Ｂ
rows.Line: Yeah, they really were! I got kinda bored during that delay, but they came over to talk to us to pass the time. And they were there to say goodbye to us.

rows.Speaker: Audience Member Ｂ
rows.Line:
I'm starting to really like them!
I might check out their channel when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Oh...
They saw things through.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Which means they just might have what it takes...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What you all did at the shoot was so awesome!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yes, it was!
I still can't believe you were able to find such a wonderful solution to that problem!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, but...
Minori deserves most of the credit for that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. It was very cool of you to do all that for the audience, Minori! You set a wonderful example for us...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking all of you. I'm honored to be receiving praise from such veteran idols...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still...
It's too bad that we're not getting that house.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah, that is kinda unfortunate...
It was a nice place, and you girls were so excited about it too.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We could've planned better.
Yes, we did give ourselves plenty of time, but scheduling both things for the same day may not have been such a great idea.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right...
We should've asked to see if we could do the interview on a different day after we heard from Saito about this shoot.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, if the landlady was as picky as advertised, then we might've gotten rejected just for asking to reschedule.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But I wouldn't worry too much about this! I'm sure you'll find another nice property.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<He's right.
You'll find one as long as you keep looking.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right!
Then, we'll call Ms. Kawanishi again and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Is someone calling?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's Saito.
This could be about that house.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hello? This is Hinomori...
I'm so sorry, Saito. Our shoot just ended.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: F-For whatever reason...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The landlady has apparently taken a liking to us, and she'd like to see us tomorrow if possible...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!
The next day
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay, we're here as requested...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But is this really gonna happen?!
What if the landlady gets mad at us for no-showing yesterday...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If she asked to see us just for that reason, then we may have a tough time dealing with her...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's our fault for not making the interview, and we already intended to apologize in person. So, let's just tell her how we feel.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
Then, I'm ringing the bell...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here goes nothing!
<Hello...?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Uhh... P-P-P-P-Pardon us!
We're MORE MORE JUMP! We have an appointment to...

<Excellent, you're here.
Just give me one second.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She seems nicer than we initially expected...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but hold on...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That voice sounded so familiar...

Thank you for waiting.
I appreciate you coming all this way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You're...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Hello.
I'm the landlady of this property.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It's you...!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: It's so nice to see you again, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-Wait a second...
If you're the landlady, then that means you're going to interview us...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, first!
We need to apologize for what happened yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sure you're already aware, but we had a shoot yesterday and...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't worry.
I understand why you had to cancel.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: More importantly, I asked you to come today because I wanted to meet all of you in person.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Since you're going to be my new tenants.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
...!
Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're approving us...?
We get to rent this house?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But why...?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Firstly, I owe you for helping me the other day.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Secondly, I realized after talking to Minori that you all just might have what it takes to make your dreams come true. In other words, you're the ideal tenants for this place.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After talking to me...?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
So, here are the keys.
You're welcome to start moving in at any time.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Also, I'm sure you've already heard that I live here on the first floor, so please feel free to let me know if you run into any trouble.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
I'm so happy since I'd really fallen in love with this house...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Me too...!
We promise to take good care of it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we did help her when she fell that time... But is that really a reason to approve us?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm not sure.
Still, she seemed to indicate that talking to Minori played a key role...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that's what it sounded like.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: People who can make their dreams come true...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Although, I'm not sure she realizes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Probably not.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It didn't occur to me when we first ran into her, but I can't shake this feeling that I've seen her before somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I can't think of when. Or I'm just imagining things...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In any case, we can finally establish our new home base... The MORE MORE HOUSE.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yeah.
Which means...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're going to spread hope to tons of people from here moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We're gonna do so much stuff together here.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Streams, editing, meetings, practice...
Right here in this house.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Right...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Others left behind those scratches as they were pursuing their dreams.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(And now I...
We're also gonna do everything we can and leave our mark on this place...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Lots of things are probably gonna happen. Some fun, some not so fun...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(As long as I have them...
As long as we get to be together like this, we should be able to handle anything that comes our way.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Everyone!
Let's keep doing our best together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's our Minori for you.

source: https://storage.sekai.best/sekai-en-assets/event_story/…（SEKAI master database + SEKAI Viewer 资源，官方文本）
